prompt: What will the woman most likely check about the spare sheet?
promptZh: 女子最可能查看那塊備用板材的哪些條件？

options.text: Whether it has room for two panels that match the finished reference panel
options.zh: 是否有空間裁出兩片與手上那片成品相符的飾板
options.whyZh: 要補足兩片，她會看面積是否足夠；帶成品去則可比對木紋方向和顏色。

options.text: Whether it has room for a complete set of twelve panels
options.zh: 是否有空間裁完整的十二片飾板
options.whyZh: 現有板材能做十片，備用板只需補另外兩片。

options.text: Whether its darker side can be moved closer to the saw
options.zh: 顏色較深的一側能否移近鋸台
options.whyZh: 較深的一側涉及配色，不是擺在鋸台哪裡。

options.text: Whether it comes from a different supplier
options.zh: 是否來自另一家供應商
options.whyZh: 要核對的是尺寸與外觀，不是採購來源。

explanationZh: 要補足兩片，她會看面積是否足夠；帶成品去則可比對木紋方向和顏色。
evidence: Ten, but there's a partially used sheet behind the saw. I'll check whether it has room for the other two. | Take a finished panel with you. That sheet is darker on one side, and the finished desk should look even in color.

vocabulary.note: partially 表示部分；已用過的板料仍可能留有可裁切的空間。
